answers.ask: How tall is the volcano - a two-minute climb or a twenty-minute one?
answers.answer: Make the starting Volcano a compact, roughly two-minute climb so the progression loop is quick and replayable.

answers.ask: Are the other four worlds separate courses, or the same climb re-skinned?
answers.answer: The other worlds should be separate courses with their own themed obstacle layouts, reached through teleport portals.

answers.ask: Is there any failure state other than falling?
answers.answer: No; falling is the only failure state, and checkpoints should respawn the player at their latest reached checkpoint.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D vertical escape-course map beginning at the bottom of a giant active volcano and rising to its summit as a compact, roughly two-minute climb. The Volcano course ascends through lava rocks, broken bridges, volcanic platforms, giant glowing crystals, and floating magma islands, with checkpoints spaced along the route and lava-filled drops below. Place teleport portals connecting this starting world to four separate themed courses: Ice Mountain, Sky Islands, Crystal Caverns, and Space Volcano, each with its own distinct obstacle layout. Use vivid lava, glowing crystals, particles, and polished volcanic lighting.
agent_notes: This is the '+1 speed' family in its purest form — +1 speed per second, crystals that raise it faster, wins spent on permanent upgrades, rebirth for a multiplier — so it is Simulation with the Stat Grinder preset, and Obby & Platformer is named second but deliberately not allowed to lead, since letting the jumping section lead would import a genre-wide P6 this family does not need. The shape is the preset's tier-ladder read as a spiral of walled sections rising up the volcano cone, so the number going up is visible as ground gained; I dropped station-training because speed here accrues passively rather than at a station, and used collectible-nodes for the glowing lava crystals that do the boosting instead. Checkpoints, portals and the summit payoff come in as checkpoint-respawn, teleporter-link and winner-zone, the eggs-and-upgrades storefront as social-hub, and the volcano itself as terrain-relief, which is what puts tiered on the route — the sections step up the cone rather than overhanging it, so no P2. Deciding without a user: the author confirmed the other four worlds are separate themed courses reached by portal, which is genuinely several maps and earns the P4 even though that route is not ready yet, so build the compact two-minute Volcano first and treat Ice Mountain, Sky Islands, Crystal Caverns and Space Volcano as queued separate maps; lava is atmosphere rather than a kill surface since the author said falling is the only failure state, and the UI, leaderboards, gamepasses and DataStore work carry no layout.
